```{r}
library(tidyverse)
mycsv <- read_csv("prac1_data/fly_tipping_borough_edit.csv", skip=1)
```
```{r}
library(sf)
# my data is within a prac1_data folder.
shape <- st_read("prac1_data/statistical-gis-boundaries-london/ESRI/London_Borough_Excluding_MHW.shp")
```

```{r}
summary(shape)
```

```{r}
plot(shape)
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
shape %>% 
  st_geometry() %>%
  plot()

shape2 <- shape%>%
  merge(.,
        mycsv,
        by.x="GSS_CODE", 
        by.y="Row Labels")

shape%>%
  head(., n=10)

library(tmap)

tmap_mode("plot")
# change the fill to your column name if different
shape2 %>%
  qtm(.,fill = "2011-12")
```
# Export
```{r}
shape%>% st_write(.,
  "prac1_data/flytipping.gpkg",
  layer = "london_boroughs_fly_tipping",
  delete_dsn = TRUE
)
```
```{R}
library(readr)
library(RSQLite)

con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(),dbname="prac1_data/flytipping.gpkg")

con %>%
  dbListTables()

con %>%
  dbWriteTable(.,
               "original_csv",
               mycsv,
               overwrite=TRUE)

con %>% 
  dbDisconnect()
```
